title.narrative: Promoting Integrated Biomass and Small Hydro Solutions for Productive Uses in Cameroon

description.narrative: Main Project (Project Identification Form -PIF) of the Preparation Phase ID 110035: Promoting Investments in the Fight against Climate Change and Ecosystems: Protection through Integrated Renewable Energy and Biomass - The goal of this project is to reduce GHG emissions through promotion of investments and a market in the scale up and replication of integrated renewable energy solutions for productive uses and industrial applications in Cameroon.
